title: Uddural taamineh tan magaala
intro: yallih racmattah aydaadih addat, ayyuntay maynaqi ximmo kobox cediyyih uddur sugte. Atu ken xaagu tablem faxxa—gersi agattiinah qadar keenik baxsa le gurral, toobokeeh, tooboke kee qanxaffe le xaagu.
clues: Nanu farmoyti akak ruuben ummattak sugneeh, kay seecok wadir nek wadir nek wadirih gacneh sugne.
yamaate digaalah astooti qaddowte wak, nanu kay maabitinah numma cedneh.
Nanu ninni Rabbih fan nuduurem baguuk toobitteeh, ni imaan oggolimteh.
Nel heen digaala ni imaan sabbatah ugutte.
Ni aydaadi digaala yubleenik geera yeemeneh yan magaaloolih fanak baxsale gurral tescessimeh tan.
Nanu kullumti yanxuqeh yan nabiyyih ummattak sugne, uxih finqak catneh.
verse: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time. (37:148)
